public_rationale: He says there 'just doesn't seem to be the investor hunger' to buy a company valued at $9.9 billion. 'Doesn't seem' marks this as an impression of buyer appetite, and 'hunger' has no measure. Interest in buying a company valued at $9.9 billion need not mean an offer at that price. So counting deals of that size would not test the claim fairly. The packet cites no evidence items. Buyer interest that appeared after the post would describe a later period, not appetite as of August 2025.
limitations: Private bids and talks from mid-2025 are mostly not public, so the records available would be incomplete even for a narrower test.
The packet cites no evidence about buyer interest in any company valued near $9.9 billion before August 2025.
